title: Measure generated-control allocation and propose one bounded recovery slice
description: Design 66 R3. Compare iteration scales and default-GC versus no-GC, with captured callbacks. Current 100k-iteration no-GC sample peaks at 1.3 GiB; that is not evidence of a leak. This issue is research/design, not authorization for that semantic change.
notes: Initial R2 full workload results/profile supplied the investigation prerequisite; relation is now related while R2 tracks final repeat acceptance. close_reason: Full isolated counters and GC/capture/length matrix completed, raw logs and formulas recorded in Design66. title: Investigate, design and plan persistent Map deletion
description:

title: Investigate, design and plan PEG matching allocation recovery
description:
## What to build

Investigate per-visit pattern vector cloning and linear named-rule lookup. Design a private immutable parse-local pattern representation and rule index, without a global cache or changing the mutable Grammar interface. Planning only.

## Acceptance criteria

- Profile small and large grammars
- preserve frozen PEG ordered choice, spans, diagnostics, zero-width guards, memo identity, aliases and GC roots
- test grammar mutation between parses and installed/source parity
- document bounded implementation steps and benchmark gates.
- Record findings and an actionable implementation plan in repository documentation, linked from this ticket.

## Blocked by

None - investigations can start independently. Only query allocation is selected for immediate implementation.

## Context

Approved five-candidate language implementation review, 2026-09-05. Respect Designs 42, 44, 60F, 60J, 63 and 66 where applicable. This ticket authorizes research/design, not unrelated runtime changes.
notes: Implemented first-wins rule index and lazy once-per-parse Rc pattern snapshots. 2088 matcher differential comparisons, deep/alias/mutation/copy-bound tests, full mise verify, 611 language tests and bounded churn passed. Host-accepted JSON timing improved 3.4%; no large speedup or total allocation claim. Performance acceptance remains OPEN: unchanged comparator exits 1 for bare/source startup regressions and missing after-docgen after host-load rejection. Dylib-startup RSS +15.3%. Evidence: docs/measurements/71-store-peg-comparison.json and Design 71. Next: quiet-host startup/docgen repeats and investigate reproducible regressions.

title: Investigate, design and plan query candidate allocation recovery
description:
## What to build

Measure avoidable triple and binding copies in query matching. Design borrowed candidate validation with result allocation only after a complete match. Plan a bounded implementation preserving repeated-variable constraints, value equality, result order, rules, negation and disjunction. User additionally authorized implementing this candidate now.

## Acceptance criteria

- Characterize baseline allocations and existing semantics
- document the selected design and alternatives
- add differential and allocation regression tests
- define pure-kernel and end-to-end verification with no dispatch, ABI, planner-order or cross-query-cache changes.
- Record findings and an actionable implementation plan in repository documentation, linked from this ticket.

## Blocked by

None - investigations can start independently. Only query allocation is selected for immediate implementation.

## Context

Approved five-candidate language implementation review, 2026-09-05. Respect Designs 42, 44, 60F, 60J, 63 and 66 where applicable. This ticket authorizes research/design, not unrelated runtime changes.
design: Selected design and implementation sequence: docs/design/67-query-candidate-allocation.md. Borrow candidate Values; validate against existing and earlier candidate bindings before constructing owned output. No planner, dispatch, ABI, snapshot or cache changes.
notes: Completed investigation, design and authorized implementation. See docs/design/67-query-candidate-allocation.md. 98,304 differential cases checked through both carriers plus scalar and wide-row tests; 1000 rejected string triples: 5000 candidate allocations to zero, fixed planner 3 unchanged; successful string triple: 4 to 2 allocations. Focused tests 21 passed, 1 manual timing ignored. Frozen-tree mise run verify passed workspace, native lifecycle, two cold archives and relocation. Fresh-prefix mise run test: 611 passed, 0 failed. Initial verification was invalidated by test-source editing and rerun successfully. Exploratory timings were noisy and are not throughput/release evidence. Other four investigations remain open, planning-only.
close_reason: Design 67 documented; query allocation implemented and verified with differential/allocation regressions, full verify and 611 language tests.

title: Reduce allocation registry metadata and index generated vtable cache

notes: Prepared compact Block metadata and BTreeMap generation/slot cache pass cargo test --workspace --locked --offline. Release prefix /tmp/birnam-throughput.To6mYL/optimized built successfully. close_reason: Implemented in ec281d1b. Four-word heap Block metadata and generation/slot BTree cache preserve provenance and lifecycle ownership. Workspace and lifecycle gates pass. title: Investigate, design and plan Store snapshot scaling
description:

title: Index weak Symbol lookup without changing identity or GC semantics
description: Implement Design 66 R1. Current isolated loop profile attributes 659/2484 leaf samples to Symbols::intern; symbol.rs scans ordered names linearly. Add a derived byte lookup index while preserving ordered enumeration, stable C-name pointers, arbitrary non-NUL bytes, weak reclamation, reinterning identity and compatibility limits. Cover compaction survivors/all-dead cycles/growth and collision handling. Benchmark hits and misses at multiple table sizes and run the same control probe plus relevant workspace, GC/image and lifecycle gates. Preserve late-bound Machine and source sends. Do not implement unrelated transport optimizations.
close_reason: Implemented in ec281d1b. Indexed weak collision-safe lookup preserves name ownership/enumeration and sweep semantics. Scaling diagnostic removes linear growth. Workspace tests, 611 module tests, control AOT/source, resumable/CodeBinding/image lifecycle, image-v8, bounded churn and project smoke pass. Full development comparison reports loop and docgen gains in Design66; R2 retains repetition/profile scope.

notes: Completed AC-powered host-gated comparison. Original optimized batch exited 1 solely for noisy boot.image timing; isolated canonical-function supplement passed. Composite preserves provenance.
